scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev
